customer_brief: We need to reduce delays in retail customer onboarding. Analysts currently review identity documents and re-enter customer details across separate systems. We want to test document extraction and verification with a human review step, while keeping an audit trail and measuring onboarding turnaround time.

customer_brief: Our MSME lending team reviews applications using financial statements, bank transaction summaries, and manually maintained checklists. We want to explore a decision-support workflow that extracts application data, highlights missing evidence, and helps underwriters prioritize cases without making autonomous credit decisions.

customer_brief: Claims handlers receive motor claims through email and a portal, then manually sort attachments and request missing information. We want to pilot claim intake classification, document summarization, and fraud-risk triage for human investigation, with clear explanations and no automated claim decisions.

customer_brief: Operations analysts investigate payment alerts from several queues and spend significant time assembling context. We want to test a fraud-triage workspace that groups related alerts, summarizes supporting evidence, and routes cases to analysts. All outcomes must remain subject to human review.
